title: How Does Your Body Feel Today?
caption: Headache or migraine feels closer to the edge today, like a bright room that won’t dim, and screens and noise may bite sooner. The space vibe is a little unsettled, not wild, so go easy and keep plans loose. Turn your brightness down, wear shades outside, sip water with small steady meals, and take short breaks between tasks.
snapshot: Geomagnetic conditions are quiet overall, with a southward-leaning magnetic field at times. Solar wind looks steady, not extreme. A couple of solar flares and CMEs were noted as background, with no signs aimed at Earth. Schumann readings are near typical levels.
affects: Headache and migraine thresholds may sit lower for some. Bright light, loud sound, and long screen sessions can feel harsher and bring on pressure sooner. Focus may wobble when head symptoms rise, then settle between waves.
playbook:
- Turn screen brightness down; use sunglasses or a cap outdoors
- Sip water regularly; small, steady meals
- Gentle neck and shoulder movement; slow breathing
- Keep tasks bite-sized and add short pauses
- If you’re sensitive, check local weather or allergens
